backupRestore.exportDescription: Nyora zvese {count} zvakachengetwa {accountLabel} mufaira rekuchengetedza. KaalKey inogadzira password yakasiyana; kopira uye chengetedza zvakasiyana kubva pafaira.
backupRestore.restoreDescription: Sarudza yako KaalKey faira rekuchengetedza uye password. Maakaundi matsva achawedzerwa kune yako iripo account runyorwa; maakaundi aripo acharamba sezvaari.

home.checkingSecureLock: Kutarisa zvigadziro zvako zvekuvhara zvakachengeteka. Makodhi ako anoramba akavanzwa.
home.secretsStayStored: Zvakavanzika zvako zvinogara zvakachengetwa pamudziyo uyu.

permissions.body: Kana ukasarudza kuongorora QR kodhi, KaalKey inoshandisa mvumo yekamera kuita izvozvo. Sarudzo yekusimbisa mudziyo uye haptic mhinduro shandisa zvinoenderana nemudziyo maficha. Iwe unogona kutonga zvibvumirano mumaseting emudziyo wako.
permissions.heading: 2. Mvumo uye zvishandiso zvemidziyo

backups.body: Kana ukagadzira backup, KaalKey inovharidzira iyo backup uchishandisa password yaunosarudza. Chengetedza zvese faira nepassword zvakavanzika uye zvichengetedze zvakachengeteka. Chero ani anowana faira uye password yaro anogona kukwanisa kudzoreredza maakaundi ako echokwadi. KaalKey haikwanise kudzoreredza password yakanganwa.
backups.heading: 3. Backups

security.body: Chengetedza mudziyo wako uchivandudzwa, chengetedza nekuvhara skrini, uye usagovane OTP zvakavanzika kana mapassword ekuchengetedza. Kubvisa app, kubvisa data rayo, kana kurasikirwa nemudziyo kunogona kuita kuti maakaunti akachengetwa munharaunda asawanikwe. Chengetedza backup yakachengeteka kana iwe uchida kupora.
security.heading: 5. Chengetedzo nekuchengetedza

information.heading: 1. Ruzivo nezvakavanzika
information.body: KaalKey iapp yechokwadi. Maakaundi mareketi uye zvakavanzika zvakakosha kuti ugadzire makodhi enguva-imwe zvinonzwisisika. Iyo app yakagadzirirwa kuchengetedza marekodhi eakaundi munzvimbo yakachengeteka yemuchina. Chero ani anogona kuwana mudziyo usina kukiiwa kana backup yatumirwa anogona kukwanisa kuwana ruzivo rwakadzama.

sharing.heading: 4. Kugovera uye vechitatu mapato
sharing.body: Kuyerera kwekuchengetedza kunogona kushandisa shizha remuchina wako kana chinhonga faira kuchengetedza, kutamisa, kana kusarudza mafaera. Maitiro ekuvanzika echero yechitatu-bato app kana sevhisi yaunosarudza inotongwa nemupi iyeye. Ichi chiziviso hachiite chirevo chegumbeze chekuti mudziyo wako, sisitimu yekushandisa, kana masevhisi akasarudzwa ekugovana haambogadzirise data.

changes.heading: 6. Shanduko uye kuonana
changes.body: Ichi chiziviso chakamisikidzwa chinogona kuvandudzwa mune ramangwana rekuburitswa kweapp. Pamibvunzo yekuvanzika, bata mushambadziri weapp kuburikidza nechiteshi chepamutemo chekutsigira chakapihwa neapp.

use.body: Unogona kushandisa KaalKey kugadzira macode ekusimbisa maakaundi awakatenderwa kuwana. Iwe une basa rekutevedzera mitemo inoshanda uye mitemo yemasevhisi aunoshandisa makodhi echokwadi.
use.heading: 1. Kushandisa kwako

protectAccounts.body: Iwe une basa rekuchengetedza mudziyo wako, zvakavanzika zveuthenticator, nzira dzekudzoreredza, ma backups ekunze, uye mapassword ekuchengetedza. Usagovane macode kana zvakavanzika nevanhu vausingavimbi navo.
protectAccounts.heading: 2. Chengetedza maakaundi ako

availability.body: Zvimiro zvinogona kuchinja pakati pekuburitswa. Iwe unofanirwa kuchengetedza iyo app yakagadziridzwa uye nguva nenguva kuona kuti yako backup uye kudzoreredza gadziriro inoshanda.
availability.heading: 5. Kuchinja uye kuwanikwa

recovery.body: KaalKey haigone kuvimbisa kuti account yese inogona kudzoserwa, kuti QR kodhi yega yega kana zvigadziriso zvichaenderana, kana kuti app ichashanda pasina kuvhiringwa kana kukanganisa. Chengetedza dzimwe nzira dzekudzorera dzakapiwa nebasa rakakodzera.
recovery.heading: 3. Hapana vimbiso yekudzorera

advice.heading: 4. Hapana mazano enyanzvi
advice.body: Iyo app ndeyekushandisa uye haipe mutemo, mari, kana kuchengetedza chiitiko-mhinduro. Kana account ikakanganiswa, tevera iyo yakakanganisika sevhisi kudzoreredza uye kuchengetedza gwara.

liability.heading: 6. Mutoro uye mutemo unoshanda
liability.body: Kusvika pazvinobvumidzwa nemutemo unoshanda, app inopihwa pasina vimbiso yekusavhiringidzwa kana kukanganisa-isina kushanda. Hapana chinhu mumashoko aya chinosiya kodzero kana mishonga isingagone kubviswa zviri pamutemo. Chero zvimwe zvipimo kana mitemo yekutonga-mutemo inofanira kuongororwa negweta rinokwanisa kune simba remuparidzi asati asunungurwa.

legal.reviewBothDocuments: Ndokumbira utarise zvinyorwa zvese usati washandisa KaalKey. Iwo anosanganisirwa muapp uye anowanikwa kunze kwenyika.
legal.reviewSPrivacy: Wongorora KaalKey ruzivo rwekuvanzika uye mazwi ekushandisa.
legal.iReadAgree: Ndakaverenga uye ndinobvumirana neChakavanzika Policy uye Mitemo Yekushandisa.
